title: Firefighters: Complete Interactive Reading Set
paragraph1: Firefighters are the people who put out fires on a nearly daily basis. They work for fire departments, which are organizations of trained professionals that keep the community safe from fires. When a fire breaks out, firefighters enter buildings to look for people and pets, rescue them, and put out the fire to prevent it from spreading. They also conduct fire drills and inspections to keep businesses and agencies safe.
paragraph2: They must be physically fit and must be able to work in harsh conditions and difficult situations. In addition to responding to fires, firefighters often help in situations that require medical attention, such as automobile accidents and gas emergencies. In addition to physical skills and knowledge, firefighters have to have strong social skills, because they must often interact with people during stressful situations.

blanks.explanation: 'On a nearly daily basis' is the standard adverbial collocation modifying 'daily'.
The relative clause 'which are organizations...' requires the present tense plural verb 'are' agreeing with 'fire departments'.
'Keep [someone] safe from fires' is the fixed collocation meaning to protect from danger.
The phrasal verb 'break out' means to start suddenly (especially for fires or crises).
'Look for' means to search for people and pets inside burning buildings.
'Put out the fire' is the phrasal verb meaning to extinguish.
The pronoun 'it' refers back to the singular noun 'the fire'.
'Fire drills and inspections' is the specific compound noun phrase for routine emergency drills.
'Keep businesses and agencies safe' means maintaining safety.

questions.prompt: Select the best sentence to complete the passage
options: Fire protection is the chief duty of a fire department.
Life in a fire department is not always exciting, but it is rewarding.
Firefighters must have a variety of skills and knowledge.

questions.answer: Firefighters must have a variety of skills and knowledge.
questions.explanation: This sentence perfectly bridges Paragraph 1 (duties of putting out fires and inspections) and Paragraph 2 (physical fitness, medical assistance, and social skills).

questions.prompt: Select the idea that is expressed in the passage
options: Firefighting requires diverse emergency abilities spanning physical fitness, medical aid, and social communication.
Fire departments focus solely on extinguishing structural blazes and do not assist in medical crises.

Automobile accident response has completely replaced building fire prevention in modern cities.
questions.answer: Firefighting requires diverse emergency abilities spanning physical fitness, medical aid, and social communication.
